images.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Draw one NEW official general guild emblem for the medieval post guild Federkiel in Aleria. The attached guild crest is the exact heraldic reference, identical in motif to the user's screenshot. Redraw it from scratch with finer decisive outlines, rich matte painted gold, bright readable green and a compact silhouette that reads as a 48 px site icon. Preserve the core visual identity: a frontal gold-rimmed pointed shield vertically divided, warm golden yellow on the viewer's left and leaf green on the right; one large ivory quill crossing both fields diagonally, feather tip up-left and nib down-right; a tightly gathered green leafy mantle with small blue accents behind, compact gold finial above, small plain folded gold scroll below. Calm medieval illustrated heraldry with soft controlled cel shading, not shiny modern vector or photorealistic metal. Clean silhouette and the entire crest comfortably within a square. Genuine transparent alpha outside the crest and between its open ornaments. No circular backing or badge, no lettering, no second crest, no drop shadow, no watermark, no painted chessboard.

Use case: stylized-concept. One square 1:1 fantasy guild hanging sign for Aleria, an isolated real medieval object that will also be used as a small archive icon. Image 1 is the Federkiel heraldic motif: viewer-left warm gold field and viewer-right green field, one large diagonal ivory quill with tip up-left and nib down-right. Paint this bold symbol across the entire front of a slightly pointed thick oak signboard; iron band on the edge, small brass rivets. Image 2 is a material and mounting reference only. This plaque unmistakably hangs from an iron wall bracket on TWO clearly visible wrought-iron hinged swing joints with pins above the board. Show the whole short bracket, articulated hinges and complete sign in a near-frontal slight three-quarter view, with clear air between bracket and board. Antique dark iron, oak bevel, matte pigment and crisp illustrated contours. Bold simple sign silhouette and quill legible as 48px icon. Entire assembly centered within square with clear margins. TRUE transparent PNG alpha outside the object and through the hinge gaps. No wall, masonry, ground, shadow beyond the object, people, writing, watermark, ornate frame or checkered background.
